known_differences.description: Special functions use reflection, continued fractions, and hypergeometric branch selection with Strict/Hardened mode guards.

threats.description: Evaluation of Gamma and Bessel functions near negative-integer poles or transition bands causes catastrophic cancellation.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-special/src/gamma.rs:165 (gamma): handles non-positive integer poles explicitly and uses reflection + Lanczos approximation across domains.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return IEEE NaN/Inf at poles matching SciPy cephes/xsf.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Return pole error or bounded value and record audit event when audited entry point is called.

threats.description: Out-of-domain parameters (e.g., negative degrees of freedom or probabilities outside [0, 1]) passed to special function inverses.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-special/src/audit.rs:72 (record_fail_closed): validates domain bounds and records AuditAction::FailClosed on domain error.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return NaN or SpecialError::DomainError matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject out-of-domain inputs fail-closed and emit FailClosed audit entry.

threats.description: Slow series convergence near unit circle |z| = 1 in hypergeometric functions 1F1 and 2F1.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-special/src/gamma.rs:196 (gammaln): switches to asymptotic expansions and transformation formulas with bounded series term budgets.
threats.strict_mode_response: Select transformation branch and cap series terms at fixed iteration budget.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Same bounded iteration cap with CASP branch selection audit trail.

threats.description: Complementary error function erfc underflow/overflow drift for large positive or negative arguments.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-special/src/error.rs:135 (erfc): uses rational Chebyshev approximations and scaled erfcx tail asymptotic expansion.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy tail scaling to subnormal floor.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Preserve exact tail scaling and guard non-finite inputs.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return SpecialError::PoleError and emit FailClosed audit event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Propagate IEEE NaN/Inf per SciPy ufunc rules.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject non-finite arguments in Hardened mode with SpecialError::NonFiniteInput.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return DomainError or NaN per routine contract.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return SpecialError::DomainError and log FailClosed event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return best partial sum or ConvergenceError.
